title: Competition Robots: FRC Drivetrains, BlockParty, and Best Designed Robot
oneLiner: Drivetrain CAD, assembly, and swerve service on two FRC robots with zero DNFs after repair cycles, plus a fully autonomous Arduino robot and an award-winning design built through a morph chart and evaluation matrix.
role: Drivetrain CAD and assembly (FRC); designer and builder
whatIOwnedSummary: On the FRC robots Excelsior and Jim, I owned drivetrain CAD and assembly, serviced the swerve modules, and sized the pneumatic regulators and flows. I also built BlockParty, a fully autonomous robot, and designed the Creative Decisions robot from concept selection through prototype.

claims.title: Owned drivetrain CAD and assembly on two FRC robots, with zero DNFs after repair cycles
claims.ownedScope: Drivetrain CAD and assembly for Excelsior and Jim; service of 8 swerve modules; pneumatic regulator and flow sizing.
claims.method: Designed the drivetrain in CAD and assembled it. Serviced 8 swerve modules through repair cycles. Sized the pneumatic regulators and flows. Laid out the robot so the parts that need service between matches are easy to reach.
claims.resultMetric: 0 DNFs after repair cycles. The maintenance-friendly layout reduced service time between matches.

claims.title: Built BlockParty, a fully autonomous robot
claims.method: Built with an Arduino, pistons, solenoids, motors, and mouse traps.

claims.title: Designed the Creative Decisions robot from morph chart to prototype; won Best Designed Robot
claims.method: Generated concepts with a morph chart, selected among them with an evaluation matrix, then built a prototype.

outcome: Zero DNFs after repair cycles on the FRC robots, a fully autonomous BlockParty robot, and Best Designed Robot for the Creative Decisions robot.
